comment_ja: 昨日は27件中14勝12敗1分、1,000円均一で📉-1,460円。累計は767件で勝った割合55.1%、戻ってきた割合-2.9%。注目点はSan Diego Padres勝利予想でオッズ2.12の高配当が💰+1,120円と貢献した一方、アンダー系が5件中4件外れと不振で収支を押し下げた。
comment_en: Yesterday went 14-12-1 across 27 picks, resulting in -1,460 yen at 1,000 yen per bet. The cumulative record stands at 767 picks with a win rate of 55.1% and a return rate of -2.9%. A highlight was the San Diego Padres moneyline at odds 2.12, returning +1,120 yen, but under bets underperformed with 4 of 5 missing, dragging the overall result into the red.
